title: Improving Information Sharing and Integration of Processes between Healthcare Clusters to Enhance Patient Experience
what_it_is: Improving Information Sharing and Integration of Processes between Healthcare Clusters to Enhance Patient Experience

sections.label: National Electronic Health Record systems
sections.summary: The NEHR shares patient summary records across care providers, with plans to expand coverage and add common pharmacy, billing and HealthHub digital services.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Health (Dr Janil Puthucheary) (for the Minister for Health)
sentences.text: The National Electronic Health Record (NEHR) system enables sharing of patient summary health records across care providers, including the three public healthcare clusters.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Health (Dr Janil Puthucheary) (for the Minister for Health)
sentences.text: We will progressively build up its coverage to include information from more healthcare providers to support care continuity.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Health (Dr Janil Puthucheary) (for the Minister for Health)
sentences.text: A common pharmacy system for the three public healthcare clusters is underway, to allow consolidation of patient information, which allows providers to have a more holistic view of patients' medications and facilitate the filling of prescriptions.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Health (Dr Janil Puthucheary) (for the Minister for Health)
sentences.text: MOH and the healthcare clusters are also developing a national charging and billing system to streamline processes and enable a more consistent experience for patients.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Health (Dr Janil Puthucheary) (for the Minister for Health)
sentences.text: Common digital services across the clusters, such as the scheduling of appointments and bill payments, are available on the national HealthHub mobile app and web portal.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Health (Dr Janil Puthucheary) (for the Minister for Health)
sentences.text: HealthHub also displays personal health records drawn from national systems, including for example, the COVID-19 vaccination records and COVID-19 test results.

sections.label: Integrating healthcare into LifeSG
sections.summary: The question asks whether the Ministry will consider integrating all healthcare functionalities into the LifeSG app, which already has over 70 Government services.

sentences.speaker: Mr Yip Hon Weng (Yio Chu Kang)
sentences.text: Will the Ministry consider integrating all healthcare functionalities into the LifeSG app, since more than 70 Government services are on that app already?

sections.label: Other portals for Government engagement
sections.summary: The passage states there are other portals and means for citizens to engage with Government, and that this engagement differs from engaging a healthcare provider.

sentences.speaker: Dr Janil Puthucheary
sentences.text: There are other portals and means through which citizens engage with Government.

sentences.speaker: Dr Janil Puthucheary
sentences.text: And the engagement with Government is different from the engagement with your healthcare provider.
